author: GamingBolt
description:
NASCAR 26 isn’t without its shortcomings. Dynamic Track never felt as influential as I expected, and the four series don’t feel sufficiently distinct to justify their inclusion (beyond simply providing multiple tiers to progress through during Career mode). 

Extensive controller recalibration meant I had to work for my immersion, but once I’d sussed out the right settings for me the patience, aggression, and precision that make stock car racing so distinctive emerged. It isn’t a flawless simulation by any means, but after countless laps chasing the perfect line, I’ve come away from NASCAR 26 with a better understanding of why this particular brand of racing can be so hypnotic.
title: NASCAR 26 Review - The Final Verdict

author: GamingBolt
description:
Sony and Microsoft have reportedly locked in the designs on PS6 and the next Xbox respectively and are ready to begin manufacturing and validating a new generation of gaming consoles to woo us with.

 Of course, nothing’s officially confirmed just yet but the rumored specs that have surfaced got us thinking about what the PS6 and Project Helix could do differently in comparison to their predecessors, and what both consoles could bring as the new goalposts in next-gen console gaming.

We’re happy to share as always, so join us as we begin raising our spyglasses to the horizon as we try to tease out more of what the next generation of gaming hardware could look and feel like when it eventually comes along.
title: PS6 40 TFLOPS vs Xbox Helix 56 TFLOPS: How Next-Gen Consoles Are Already Taking Shape

author: GamingBolt
description:
The Witcher 3 Remastered is nearly here, and it’s definitely exciting to consider the prospect of taking on Eredin and the Wild Hunt again. We’ve been quite chatty about all the new things it’s bringing to The Continent, but with new information that we believe deserves a light shone on it, we’re diving into a new list of things you should know before you decide to jump into a new playthrough, or start your very first one ever! 

From rendering improvements to combat camera changes there’s a fair bit of change coming to a title you might remember differently. No matter the platform you’re thinking about playing this one on, we’ve got information you’re going to find useful, so jump right on to your horses and join us.
title: The Witcher 3 Remastered vs. Original - What's CHANGING? [New Details]
